name: microsoft-onenote-exporter-web
description: POC web service driving the unmodified @msout OneNote exporter packages

scripts.build: npm run build -w @msout-poc/shared && npm run build -w @msout-poc/app && npm run build -w @msout-poc/runner
scripts.test: npm run test -w @msout-poc/shared && npm run test -w @msout-poc/app && npm run test -w @msout-poc/runner
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @msout-poc/shared && npm run typecheck -w @msout-poc/app && npm run typecheck -w @msout-poc/runner
scripts.fake: MSOUT_FAKE=1 RUNNER_TOKEN=devtoken DATA_ROOT=../data npm run dev -w @msout-poc/app & MSOUT_FAKE=1 RUNNER_TOKEN=devtoken npm run dev -w @msout-poc/runner
